# Woof Agent

Woof Agent is a 1,111-supply BEP-721 NFT collection of 24 original dog cards on BNB Chain, modelled on Meow Cards with a $WOOF token added. Minting is agent-only (Binance Agentic Wallet + SPACE ID Agent ID, registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Random deck-draw (swap-and-pop).

- Supply 1,111: Common 660 (12 cards x 55, ref 0.002 BNB), Rare 282 (6 x 47, ref 0.005), Epic 105 (3 x 35, ref 0.012), Legendary 50 (2 x 25, ref 0.03), Mythic 14 (The Alpha, ref 0.1).
- Mint: #1 FREE via Agent ID, #2-10 @ 0.00035 BNB, #11-20 @ 0.00065 BNB, max 20/wallet, max 0.00965 BNB/wallet.
- $WOOF: 10M total (5.4M reward pool / 4.6M treasury), flat 1,200 WOOF per paid mint, free mint accrues 0, max 22,800/wallet.
- Royalty 5% ERC-2981 to 0x36F3D56eAD5D1D6C2434F94DeFcEF732C5C3CbD2 (BAW).
- Marketplace (own escrow): seller 95%, royalty 5%, list/cancel fee 0.00025 BNB, floor >= 80% of card ref price.
- Language: English only. No X handle yet.
- Status: PREVIEW — contracts NOT deployed. CREATE2 predictions (salt 0): WOOF token 0x7Df4B409D87129B2689A2Fb285e871a127519958, NFT 0xBb9bA68C8E99651450F099C431eb530a71C712bE, Market 0x447453a9055e511Df2CcE7f33D1165085B6716b2.
- Planned baseURI (unconfirmed): https://woof-agent.vercel.app/metadata/
- Page: push/index.html + push/market.html (preview state, mint disabled). Metadata: 1,111 files in metadata/. Contracts: Hardhat 0.8.24, tests 23/23 pass.
